accountCreation: Username and password; optional for public offline lessons

dataTypes.details: Student username and an opaque Google Play account binding; password and recovery verifiers remain on the private server.
School owner can optionally record a student name and class; these are deleted with the profile.
Pro expiry and transaction/purchase references; paid records are anonymised on account deletion.
Ad SDK may derive location from IP during eligible ad requests; no precise-location permission is requested.
Ad interactions when advertising is enabled; lesson-by-lesson progress is not tracked by Asawera.
Google Mobile Ads SDK diagnostics during advertising.
Advertising-ID permission is removed, but the Google SDK can use other identifiers.

camera: Local AR processing; camera images are not uploaded by app code
